name: observe
description: Read current actual RGB-D scene evidence from selected public views. Use when: another physical camera or derived point-cloud view would resolve uncertainty; the current agentview is already delivered automatically. Effect: read-only; stores derived overlays but neither recaptures nor advances the world. Returns: observation_id, views, view_dimensions, grip_xyz_m, aperture_mm and aperture_limits_mm, with actual-view image blocks; aperture_mm is the normalized Panda opening times nominal 80 mm, not a separately calibrated aperture. Does not: expose object identity, hidden state or task success; derived point clouds add no new sensor evidence. On error: choose agentview, wrist or a named point-cloud view and use the returned native dimensions for pixels.

views.description: Unique public view names; omitted or null selects agentview. Physical RGB views retain their returned native size; pointcloud_top/front/side are derived views.

history_point_ids.description: Previously solved point identifiers to overlay; omitted or null adds no history marks. Identifiers are local measurement references, not object identities.
